import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog', program_path)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def make_board(n, markers):
    size = n*4 + (n-1)
    g = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
    for k in range(n-1):
        q = k*5+4
        for j in range(size): g[q][j]=8; g[j][q]=8
    for tr,tc,lr,lc,color in markers:
        g[tr*5+lr][tc*5+lc]=color
    return g
# Demonstration input: 6x6 array of 3x3 interiors separated by 8; marker local location is center.
demo = [[0]*22 for _ in range(22)]
for k in range(5):
    q=3+4*k
    for j in range(22): demo[q][j]=8; demo[j][q]=8
def setmark(g,tr,tc,lr,lc,v): g[tr*4+lr][tc*4+lc]=v
setmark(demo,0,1,1,1,2); setmark(demo,4,1,1,1,2)
setmark(demo,2,0,1,1,3); setmark(demo,2,4,1,1,3)
out_demo=mod.transform(demo)
expected_demo=[[0]*22 for _ in range(22)]
for k in range(5):
    q=3+4*k
    for j in range(22): expected_demo[q][j]=8; expected_demo[j][q]=8
# tile-fill helper using 3x3 tile ranges
for tr,tc,color in [(tr,1,2) for tr in range(5)]:
    pass
for tr in range(5):
    col=6 if tr==2 else 2
    for r in range(tr*4,(tr*4)+3):
        for c in range(4,7): expected_demo[r][c]=col
for tc in range(5):
    col=6 if tc==1 else 3
    for r in range(8,11):
        for c in range(tc*4,(tc*4)+3): expected_demo[r][c]=col
print('demo match',out_demo==expected_demo)
# Test input exact marker layout
T = [[0]*28 for _ in range(28)]
for k in range(5):
    q=4+5*k
    for j in range(28): T[q][j]=8; T[j][q]=8
for tr,tc,lr,lc,v in [(1,0,1,2,2),(1,4,1,2,2),(3,0,1,2,2),(0,2,1,2,3),(4,2,1,2,3)]:
    T[tr*5+lr][tc*5+lc]=v
answer=mod.transform(T)
print('dims',len(answer),len(answer[0]),'colors',sorted(set(v for row in answer for v in row)))
